channel.title: Would I Lie to You?
channel.desc: Rob Brydon is back in the host's chair for the award-winning comedy panel show, with Lee Mack and David Mitchell returning as the lightning-quick team captains. Each week, a stellar cast of celebrity guests reveal extraordinary stories about themselves. But are they telling the truth, or are they making it all up? Sorting the fact from the fiction this week are guests Julie Hesmondhalgh, Chris McCausland, Yinka Bokinni and Harriet Kemsley.
